newsitem.title: UK: Tesco shares gain in short squeeze.
newsitem.headline: Tesco shares gain in short squeeze.

text.p: Shares in British supermarket group Tesco Plc and other leading food retailers rose on Friday, squeezed higher as recent demand left market-makers short of stock, dealers said.
"It is just the old story of market-makers running around looking for stock," said one senior dealer.
Tesco -- which rose 12 percent in July -- was up 11p to 423 by 0856 GMT, J Sainsbury Plc was up 4-1/2p to 430-1/2, Safeway Plc gained 4-1/2p to 389 and ASDA Group Plc rose 1-1/4p to 143-1/2.
Volume in ASDA reached 4.7 million shares, making it the second most active stock in the FTSE 100.

Dealers noted food retailers had lost ground early in the week as a retreat in sterling lured some investors out of domestic stocks and into overseas earners. Since then however the pound has rallied.
